title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Financial Management → Grants / Sponsored Programs
architecture_notes: Workday Grants Management handles the full sponsored programs lifecycle: award setup, budget management, effort certification, cost sharing, billing/draw-down, and closeout. Grants are a first-class worktag in Workday — every transaction coded to a grant automatically flows into grant financial reporting. This is a critical module for research universities. The Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) governs allowable costs, cost principles, and audit requirements for federal awards.

source_objects.description: Award/grant header: sponsor, PI, title, award amount, project period, CFDA number, billing type (cost-reimbursable, fixed-price). Equivalent to PS_GM_AWD_HDR + PS_GM_AWD_PRJ.
Budget by grant/period/cost category. Equivalent to PS_GM_BUDGET_DTL. Direct costs, indirect costs (F&A), cost sharing.
Parent/child structure: award → subaward → task/phase. Tracks budget at each level.
Faculty/staff effort reporting (% of time on each grant). Required for federal compliance. Equivalent to effort certification in PS Grants.
Funding agency: federal (NSF, NIH, DOE, DOD), state, private foundation, industry. Equivalent to PS_GM_SPONSOR.
Invoice/draw-down against a grant. Letter of credit (LOC) draws for federal awards, invoices for others.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Institution's internal grant number.
The sponsor's reference number (e.g., NIH grant number, NSF award number).
Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance number. Required for federal awards. Direct map.
Resolve to name. The faculty lead.
Sum of direct + indirect budgets across all periods.
Sum of direct cost budget lines.
F&A/overhead. Calculated using the institution's negotiated IDC rate.
Negotiated F&A rate (e.g., 55.5% MTDC for on-campus organized research). May vary by activity type and location.
Institutional commitment (mandatory or voluntary cost sharing).
Map to HELIX fund code. Federal grants → restricted_federal, state → restricted_state, etc.

compliance_notes: Federal grants are subject to 2 CFR 200 (Uniform Guidance). Key requirements: allowable cost determination, effort certification (at least semi-annually), A-133/Uniform Guidance single audit for institutions spending ≥$750K in federal awards. F&A rates negotiated with cognizant federal agency (usually DHHS or ONR). Cost sharing must be tracked and documented. Equipment (>$5K) purchased on federal grants is subject to disposition rules.
